description: This file defines a template interface 'IIteratorType' for iterators within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It specifies methods for navigating through a collection, such as Next, Previous, Reset, IsValid, Count, and retrieving the current element.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A template interface for iterator operations over elements of type ELEMENT, identified by INTERFACE_ID.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, outputting it through the info parameter.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, outputting it through the info parameter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current position of the iterator is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element the iterator points to.
